questions.question: When an angel of the Lord appeared to the priest Zechariah beside the altar of incense, how did Zechariah react?

answers.text: He was startled and gripped with fear
He bowed and asked the angel's name
He calmly finished burning the incense

questions.question: The angel told the priest Zechariah that only his own family would rejoice at the birth of his son John. True or false?
The angel told Zechariah his son John would be great in the Lord's sight. What would John be filled with, even from his mother's womb?
Because Zechariah did not believe the angel Gabriel's promise of a son, what happened to him?

answers.text: He became silent and unable to speak
He became blind until the boy was born
He lost his place as a priest
